messages.author: cae0406930058f15
messages.subject: no plots via rpy2
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to call ggplot2 from the python rpy2 module. All of the
ggplot2s I've tried don't draw anything; the devices are left blank,
and there are no errors. Something like

attach(mtcars)
qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars)

works exactly as it should when I run them directly in the native R
shell. Normal plotting works just fine from rpy2.

I've tried using png and X11.

Thanks for any tips,

Homer

messages.subject: Re: no plots via rpy2
parts:
What about:

# ---
from rpy2.robjects.packages import importr
datasets = importr("datasets")

# qplot() is not (yet) in robjects.lib.ggplot2
r_ggplot2 = importr("ggplot2")
import rpy2.robjects.lib.ggplot2 as ggplot2

p = r_ggplot2.qplot('mpg', 'wt', data=datasets.mtcars)
p.plot()
# ---


More documentation on using ggplot2 with rpy2 at:
http://rpy.sourceforge.net/rpy2/doc-2.1/html/graphics.html#package-ggplot2
